figures.name: Chukwu

ability.name: Great Spirit
ability.description: Reset all enemy negative effects on allies; grant +2 to all ally stats.

figures.description: The supreme Igbo creator god whose name means 'Great Spirit' and who governs all of existence.

figures.name: Ala

ability.name: Earth Law
ability.description: No enemy can commit an immoral action: all dark alignment cards lose 3 to all stats.

figures.description: Earth goddess and moral authority of the Igbo; all crimes against her law are the most serious offenses.

figures.name: Amadioha

ability.name: Thunder of Justice
ability.description: Strike one evil-alignment enemy for 8 damage; restore 2 HP to all allies.

figures.description: Sky god of thunder and lightning who executes divine justice, striking down those who commit ala violations.

figures.name: Agwu

ability.name: Diviners' Madness
ability.description: Reveal all hidden enemy cards; grant one ally +3 magic from divine inspiration.

figures.description: Trickster god of divination and healing whose gifts of insight come with madness as their companion.

figures.name: Ekwensu

ability.name: Bargain of War
ability.description: Force one enemy to trade their highest stat for a 3 HP restoration to this card.

figures.description: God of bargaining and change who was later demonized but originally governed the challenging aspects of life.

figures.name: Ikenga

ability.name: Right Hand Power
ability.description: One ally may perform two actions this turn from the power of personal achievement.

figures.description: The personal spirit of the right hand that governs ambition, achievement and the power to act.

figures.name: Ogbuide

ability.name: Lake's Treasure
ability.description: Steal 2 stats from the wealthiest enemy and add them to this card.

figures.description: Beautiful mermaid goddess of Oguta Lake who brings wealth to those who honor her and illness to those who offend.

figures.name: Mmuo

ability.name: Masquerade Arrival
ability.description: Materialize from the spirit world: deal 4 damage to one enemy ignoring defense.

figures.description: The spirits of the dead who return in masquerade form to communicate with and guide the living.

figures.name: Anyanwu

ability.name: Solar Vision
ability.description: Grant one ally the ability to see all hidden or invisible cards for 2 turns.

figures.description: The sun itself as a divine entity — the visible eye of Chukwu gazing down on human affairs.

figures.name: Ogwugwu

ability.name: Chi Strength
ability.description: The next ability this card uses deals +3 bonus damage from concentrated chi.

figures.description: God of personal strength and power associated with the individual chi that grants each person their force.

figures.name: Njoku Ji

ability.name: Yam Festival
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; grant +2 power to all earth and harvest allies.

figures.description: God of the yam harvest whose festival marks the most important celebration of the Igbo year.

figures.name: Imo Miri

ability.name: River Spirit
ability.description: Drain 2 HP from one enemy per turn for 2 turns and add to own HP.

figures.description: The female spirit of the Imo River who governs all water spirits in Igbo territory.

figures.name: Ogbanje

ability.name: Cyclical Curse
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, deal 3 damage to the enemy who destroyed it before returning.

figures.description: Malevolent spirit children who are born, die young and are reborn repeatedly in a cycle of grief.

figures.name: Ekpe

ability.name: Secret Society
ability.description: Activate a hidden ability that enemies cannot predict or counter.

figures.description: Leopard spirit of the powerful Ekpe secret society that governs law, politics and spiritual affairs.

figures.name: Odinani

ability.name: Sacred Custom
ability.description: All enemy disruption and chaos abilities are reduced in power by 2 this turn.

figures.description: The spirit of Igbo traditional law and sacred custom that governs proper relations between humans and gods.

figures.name: Agbara

ability.name: Natural Force
ability.description: All nature and earth abilities gain +2 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The divine power or spiritual force that inhabits natural phenomena, objects and sacred places.

figures.name: Eze Nri

ability.name: Ritual Purification
ability.description: Remove all curses and dark debuffs from all allies simultaneously.

figures.description: The sacred king of Nri whose ritual authority purified abominations and maintained cosmic order without violence.

figures.name: Mmo

ability.name: Otherworldly Form
ability.description: Take on spirit form: enemy cannot use targeted single abilities against this card for 1 turn.

figures.description: The masquerade spirit who appears at festivals and funerals, existing between the human and spirit worlds.

figures.name: Onwa

ability.name: Moon Time
ability.description: All timing-based abilities this turn trigger at the optimal moment for your side.

figures.description: The moon personified as a spirit who marks time, governs female cycles and organizes the Igbo calendar.

figures.name: Uju

ability.name: Abundance Gift
ability.description: Grant one ally +2 to two different stats from the spirit of giving.

figures.description: The spirit of fullness and abundance whose generosity flows through those who give freely to others.
